description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 scores for several models across seven datasets. The horizontal axis represents the dataset, labeled “Dataset”, with categories including SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, listed in that order. The vertical axis represents the F1 score, labeled “F1 Score (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Four sets of bars are presented for each dataset, representing the models MADLLM, MADLLM w/o prompt pool, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding, colored green, blue, purple, and red respectively. For the SMD dataset, the F1 scores are approximately 96, 91, 93, and 88 for MADLLM, MADLLM w/o prompt pool, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding, respectively. The WADI dataset shows the lowest scores across all models, with values of approximately 72, 68, 74, and 70. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing four bars representing the different models. No bars are visually emphasized, and the datasets are presented in a fixed order.
